findings.F1: Sense 1 example 'The roof was leaked by the rain.' is an impossible passive: the container cannot be the object of transitive leak.
findings.F2: Sense 3 definition says leaking secrets happens 'usually by mistake'; it is usually deliberate.
findings.F3: Collocation 'a tap leaks' uses the British word; American English typically says 'a faucet leaks'.
